bio: Liam P. Hardy is a Judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces. Before joining the court, he served as a Deputy Assistant Attorney General in the U. S. Department of Justice’s Office of Legal Counsel and as a litigation partner in the Washington D.C. office of Kirkland & Ellis LLP. Judge […]
